changes.area: Checklist documents in the author profile
changes.implemented: Distinct families for saved evidence, actually referenced guidance images and exact original sources. Cards preserve the saved record, real pre/post phase and template revision. Guidance usages show introduction/steps without treating them as execution photos.
changes.limits: The creator of the checklist is not asserted to be the photographer or owner of every document. No name-based association is introduced. Backend eligibility and current permissions remain authoritative.

changes.implemented: Logbook mount and Fleet-scoped aliases. List distinguishes extracted spreadsheet content and reference images; offers the authoritative onOpenLogReference callback, verified image downloads and explicit unavailable-image counts.
changes.limits: No original Excel download is invented; no execution evidence or personal profile relationship is inferred. Fleet=true only changes the exact approved logbook aliases, not access policy.

changes.implemented: All record/source links now guard current account, route, host, external activity, mount identity and list generation. A list refresh, new mount, account change, page change or modal closure invalidates earlier actions. Download guards execute before transport and after transport, byte extraction and SHA calculation.
changes.finding_corrected: Previously a download initiated on an older list could complete after Refresh documents because the card only checked account and route. Current card generation now prevents that stale completion.
changes.limits: Already downloaded files cannot be recalled. Current server permission checks remain necessary; the frontend does not claim to detect a remote permission change without a new request.

changes.implemented: Files still require matching byte length and SHA256. SHA-based guidance/reference identifiers must match their declared digest. Checklist phase mismatches fail before transport. Logbook reference records must belong to the mounted book. New source links wrap and have a 44px minimum height; actions use explicit text. Reference review timestamps display localised date/time while saved UTC remains unchanged.
changes.limits: No browser layout, keyboard traversal, assistive-technology or physical-device test was performed. No colour palette change was made.

previews.kind: actual component HTML with fictitious real API envelopes; not screenshots
previews.source_extraction: test_ui133_context_documents_api_fixture.cjs runs AJContextDocuments.mount with shipped code and serializes its real DOM before exercising download refusal. It writes ui133-checklist-api-markup.html and ui133-logbook-api-markup.html.
previews.packaging: Generator copies the runtime shell stylesheet order, local assets and the actual Portuguese help article. Operational buttons and record links are explicitly inactive in the offline copy; the help remains local.
previews.comparison: Both pages show UI133. A textual note identifies the difference from UI132; no historical screen is reconstructed.
previews.limitations: No browser, screenshot, pixel inspection or responsive layout measurement. The 390px control is an inspection aid only, not a mobile-test claim. Copy the whole directory, including styles/ and assets/.
